# Millida animation attribution

Source: https://github.com/millida/launcher/blob/main/src/vendor/mine3d/core/skin-animations.ts
License: GPL-3.0-only (MILLIDA-LICENSE). Copyright belongs to the upstream contributors.

Nova adaptation: selected nine animation classes, transpiled TypeScript to browser JavaScript, added factory; Nova controller blends poses and preserves the skinview3d rig pivot positions. Original upstream source is included in millida-skin-animations.original.ts.

When distributing the combined launcher using this GPL code, provide corresponding source under GPL-3.0-only and preserve notices and license.
